title: Classes with Linda Keehl
summary: The charcuterie fun cooking class on September 3rd is canceled due to low enrollment. Cookie decorating will be the last class of the season, details to follow.
public_detail: Sept. Cooking Class Wed. Sept. 3rd Cooking Class: Charcuterie Fun is canceled due to not enough signed up to be able to hold class. Those that are signed up and paid will have their money returned to them. Watch for our last class of the season to be announced with date and time for Oct. We will be doing cookie decorating. Sept.
